decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The
proposal, by reason of failing to provide private rear amenity space for the FF
flat, would result in a poor standard of living accommodation for future
occupiers of those flats, to the detriment of their residential amenities,&nbsp; contrary to the National Planning Policy
Framework (2023), Policies D6 and D3, of the London Plan (2021), Policies DM 1
and DM 26 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013),
The&nbsp; Mayor of London Housing
Supplementary Planning Guidance (2016), the adopted Supplementary Planning
Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and Housing Design Standards LPG
(2023).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The proposal, by reason of the refuse and waste recycling
bins and bicycle stores, in the front garden area, would result in a cluttered
and poor quality environment and would fail to provide adequate secure cycle
parking, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the subject
property and the street scene and the objectives of promoting sustainable
transport, contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National
Planning Policy Framework (2023), Core Policy CS.1B of the Harrow Core
Strategy, Policies D3.D1, D.11 and T5 of the London Plan (2021), Policies DM 1,
DM 26, DM23, DM42 and DM45 of the Development Management Policies Local Plan
(2013) and the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design
Guide (2010).&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The proposal, by reason of failing to provide adequate
and acceptable vertical stacking for the future residents of the GF flat, would
result in a poor standard of living accommodation for future occupiers of this
flat, to the detriment of their residential amenities, contrary to the National
Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D6 and D3, of the London Plan
(2021), Policies DM 1 and DM 26 of the Harrow Development Management Policies
Local Plan (2013), The&nbsp; Mayor of London
Housing Supplementary Planning Guidance (2016), the adopted Supplementary
Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and Housing Design Standards
LPG (2023).<span style="font-size:11.0pt;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The proposal, by reason of the insufficient number of
cycle storage provided within the front amenity space, would result in the
unsatisfactory provision of safe cycle storage facilities, to provide facilities
for all the users of the site and in the interests of highway safety and
sustainable transport, contrary to the National
Planning Policy Framework (2023), &nbsp;Policy T5 of The London Plan (2021) and Policy
DM 42 of the Harrow Development Management Policies (2013).<span style="font-size:11.0pt;mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p class="MsoNoSpacing">The
proposal, by reason of failing to provide minimum bedroom widths for the future
residents of the single occupancy bedroom in the GF Flat, as well as a narrow and cramped kitchen space for the FF flat, would result in a poor standard of
living accommodation for future occupiers of those flats, to the detriment of
their residential amenities,&nbsp; contrary to
the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D6 and D3, of the
London Plan (2021), Policies DM 1 and DM 26 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013), The&nbsp;
Mayor of London Housing Supplementary Planning Guidance (2016), the
adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010) and
Housing Design Standards LPG (2023).<span style="font-size:11.0pt;
mso-bidi-font-family:&quot;Times New Roman&quot;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>
description: Conversion of dwelling into two flats (1 X 2 bed and 1 X 1 bed); bin and cycle stores
